definitions.backend_hashes: actual computations performed by the selected mining backend itself; verification and rescan work never included
definitions.candidate_count: candidates the backend presented for independent verification
definitions.device_hashes: actual computations performed by a CUDA device; exactly 0 when no CUDA device executed work

identities.cpu_and_c: device_hashes == 0 and backend_hashes + verification_hashes == total actual computations (the legacy hashes key)
identities.cuda_driver: device_hashes == unique_coverage + researched_hashes and backend_hashes == device_hashes (CUDA-scoped only)

definitions.overflow_splits: range subdivisions caused by candidate-buffer overflow during recovery
definitions.requested_hashes: computations the caller asked for (nonce-range size); a request is not work
definitions.researched_hashes: additional backend computations repeating already-covered work (CUDA overflow recovery); a subset of backend_hashes, on the CUDA path of device_hashes
definitions.unique_coverage: distinct nonces actually covered; full range on completed enumerations; distinct nonces examined before stopping on early-exit paths; null with a note when not exactly measurable
definitions.verification_hashes: actual computations by the independent verification and recovery layer: one per candidate presented for verification, plus every trusted-rescan computation (enumeration digests and per-find re-verifications)
